en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large central square in a European city. The view looks down over an open plaza with landscaped flowerbeds and a tall Baroque-style column monument in the foreground, and an equestrian statue on a pedestal further back. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with pitched roofs; on the left stands a prominent tower with a clock and a domed structure behind it. The reverse side is a divided back with printed address lines and Hungarian text including the city and place name.
